description: This file defines types, functions, and utilities for configuring and resolving provider request settings, including authentication, TLS, proxy, headers, and request policies, within a software project. It manages request overrides, header merging, and policy resolution for provider requests.

methods.name: sanitizeConfiguredRequestString
methods.description: Sanitizes a string request value, trimming whitespace and asserting secret resolution.

methods.name: sanitizeConfiguredProviderRequest
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a provider request or transport override object.

methods.name: sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest
methods.description: Alias for sanitizeConfiguredProviderRequest for model provider requests.

methods.name: mergeProviderRequestOverrides
methods.description: Merges multiple ProviderRequestTransportOverrides objects into one.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a base URL by trimming and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: mergeProviderRequestHeaders
methods.description: Merges multiple header sets, handling case-insensitive keys and conflicts.

methods.name: resolveTlsOverride
methods.description: Resolves TLS override settings into a TLS config, throwing if insecureSkipVerify is true.

methods.name: resolveAuthOverride
methods.description: Resolves authentication override settings into a normalized auth config.

methods.name: sanitizeRuntimeProviderRequestOverrides
methods.description: Sanitizes runtime provider request overrides, disallowing proxy and TLS settings.

methods.name: resolveProxyOverride
methods.description: Resolves proxy override settings into a proxy config.

methods.name: applyResolvedAuthHeader
methods.description: Applies authentication header overrides to existing headers.

methods.name: toTlsConnectOptions
methods.description: Converts TLS config into options suitable for TLS connection setup.

methods.name: buildProviderRequestDispatcherPolicy
methods.description: Builds a dispatcher policy based on proxy and TLS configurations.

methods.name: buildProviderRequestTlsClientOptions
methods.description: Generates TLS client options from the TLS configuration.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestPolicyConfig
methods.description: Resolves the full request policy configuration including base URL, capabilities, headers, and security settings.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestConfig
methods.description: Resolves the complete provider request configuration for a given provider.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestHeaders
methods.description: Resolves headers for a provider request based on various input parameters.

methods.name: attachModelProviderRequestTransport
methods.description: Attaches provider request transport overrides to a model object.

methods.name: getModelProviderRequestTransport
methods.description: Retrieves provider request transport overrides from a model object.
